22.9. A page whose headings carry the content

9.1 A section with prose under it

Prose under the first heading, which is the ordinary shape.

9.2 Documents that are not made available for public inspection can be requested under the Freedom of Information Act.

9.3 A second section with prose under it

Prose under the third heading.

9.4 The Registrar will not acknowledge claims that information is confidential.

5 See AKT Consultants Pty Ltd v Alfa Laval Lund AB (2006) 70 IPR 347.
